reviews.text: Friendly, professional, and with a great price, absolutely top-notch ❤️
Everything was great, super friendly and very fast

For 16 years, this has been my trusted veterinary clinic. The service is impeccable, the attention completely personalized, and the follow-up care for my cat Negrita, who has unfortunately had serious health problems, has been excellent.

I feel I'm in very good hands: they support and advise me every step of the way, and each time we visit, they dedicate the time and attention she needs. They also have an oncology service, thanks to which I have felt especially supported throughout the entire process.

I can only express my gratitude for the care, professionalism, and friendliness of the entire team. Highly recommended.
I've taken both my cats to this clinic and they are excellent professionals. They not only gave them timely medical attention, but also continued to check on their progress. Thank you so much!
Highly recommended. They are kind, friendly, and very caring with the animals. Their explanations are clear…a top-notch clinic.
Excellent professionals and a very friendly and caring approach to pets.

Thank you so much, Manuel, for your 5-star review.
It was a pleasure to see Curro for his appointment with our oncology specialist. We greatly appreciate the trust you placed in our team and are delighted to hear that your experience at the clinic was positive.

We will continue to be available to support and assist you with anything Curro may need.

Sincerely, The Chihuahua Veterinary Clinic Team
Thank you so much, Marga! 😊 We're thrilled to receive your feedback. Thank you for trusting us and for being part of the Chihuahua family. Big hugs! 🐾💙 …
Very good experience with my dog ​​in terms of vaccinations and care.

They were incredibly professional and attentive. We arrived with our dog in an emergency, and they gave him a thorough examination. After analyzing the blood work, they explained each and every parameter and their relationship to one another, as well as answering any questions we had. They are truly excellent professionals and a fantastic clinic, without a doubt. We will definitely use their services again for anything we need. They were attentive to our dog's progress for 24 hours. Thank you so much.
Excellent service, very professional and caring staff with my cat
Excellent care for pets, involvement with problems
My dog ​​got sick and they saw us without an appointment. They were fantastic and treated us wonderfully.
The service is incredibly professional, friendly, and personalized. They inspire calm and confidence. I would especially like to highlight the care that veterinarian Alba shows to the pets.

Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in Madrid!! After visiting a few times, I can say that the treatment of kittens is always perfect, they are always super attentive and willing to help, and the prices are very competitive!! If you want good service, come here!

Excellent service and amazing professionals.
We took our kitten Eddie to this clinic during a very difficult time, with a prognosis that wasn't what we expected, and yet we can only express our gratitude. The dedication, discretion, and above all, the human touch we received were absolutely incredible until the very end.

We especially want to thank Alba, the veterinarian, for her impeccable care and outstanding professionalism. The way she cared for and comforted Eddie was simply masterful, with a sensitivity and affection we will never forget.
The clinic owner himself loves animals as if they were his own, and that dedication and passion is palpable throughout the entire team. You can tell they work from the heart.
We will have more pets, because they are true angels and machines of love, and we will definitely return here without hesitation.
A great center, congratulations on the wonderful work you do, and thank you, truly, for being there for us during such a difficult time.

The staff are all incredibly kind and caring. They treated our pet Eddie with professionalism and efficiency at all times, including for unscheduled emergencies. Although their clinic is quite far from our home, they are our go-to vet. We are delighted with them.
Excellent service, very professional.

Hi Angel, we're updating our review to let you know that Kira has also left a huge void for us. She was always a loving dog with a unique personality that we'll never forget, and an example of a fighter for everyone. Our deepest condolences to the whole family. Sending you a big hug.

Previous message: Hi Angel, thank you so much for your rating, comment, and for your trust over the years. We try to be affectionate with all our pets to reduce the stress they experience when coming to the clinic, and with Kira, it was quite a challenge to build the trust that we now reciprocate. Kira is a very special dog to us. Sending you a big hug.

I just adopted two kittens and I'm feeling so lost!! I couldn't be happier that I chose this veterinary clinic. From the very first moment, they've been friendly, kind, and incredibly professional. They're always available to support me, answer my questions, and help me with everything I need, which has been absolutely essential for me.

My kittens are calm when they go there, and you can see the love and care they receive. It's so reassuring to know they're in such good hands.
Thank you so much for everything ❤️
Thank you for your feedback, a big hug.

Even though I didn’t have an appointment, due to an urgent situation I brought my cat here for the first time because of an allergy and infection. They took care of her very gently, tried to calm her down with special treats, and explained everything about her condition in great detail. They also speak English well! Highly recommended — 100/100!
Excellent clinic, good treatment and even better care, at least for my dog ​​Dobby.

I left delighted. I took Simba to this clinic for a mouth infection; I'd heard good things about it and was quite worried because he's a very small breed and they would have to put him under full sedation. Everything went perfectly, and they've been very attentive to his recovery ever since. I highly recommend them, especially since their prices are affordable. I got several quotes from different places, and this one was half the price. In short, I'll definitely be using this clinic as my go-to place.

I'm delighted with the service. Midas loves going to the vet, hehe, and they always treat him with so much care. The checkups are excellent, and they remind us when his vaccinations or deworming are due in case we've forgotten, which is fantastic for me.
Excellent attention, care and empathy.

The care at the clinic was excellent. I especially want to highlight Alba, a true professional, very friendly and caring at all times. She inspired a lot of confidence in me and treated my pet with exceptional care and dedication. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic.

Alba, the girl who helped me, is lovely. I called for an emergency and she squeezed me in right away. They simply want your pet to be okay, without unnecessary tests. I've definitely found a vet I can trust!
Thank you Francisco for your feedback!
Thanks David for your feedback! Best regards!

Yesterday I took Duque to this veterinary clinic because he suddenly got sick! It wasn't my usual clinic (because it was far away and I didn't know them), but he needed someone to check him out. The service was excellent, both from the young man and the vet who examined Duque. I was very happy, and the best part is that Duque is doing great! Thank you so much!
The service is excellent and they care deeply about the animals.

I've been taking my kittens to this vet for several months now, and they've helped me countless times! The whole team of doctors is amazing. I'm so happy and wholeheartedly recommend Chihuahua Veterinary Clinic.
The team at this clinic is excellent; they are kind and took wonderful care of my cat. I am very grateful.

I write this from the heart; you won't find a better clinic. I've been going to them for 20 years, and Edu stands out for his empathy and kindness. He makes the clinic a home and a refuge for us and our pets, especially during the most difficult times when they're sick.
The veterinarians and assistants are equally exceptional. They accompany and help you with great warmth. They have a true calling that you can feel in every interaction with our pets, and we are so grateful.
You'll never see them trying to rip you off with unnecessary medications or treatments. They always try to minimize the impact on our pets when they're at the vet.
They're always attentive to them, going beyond the consultation itself, caring for them and for you as part of a big family. I can only express my gratitude for so much love.
They're the best, we've had them since day one, Bombo is happy and so are we.

We just adopted Athos, and we didn't yet have a trusted vet. This afternoon I called urgently because he'd fallen ill, and they squeezed me in to see him right away.
They were incredibly kind, explained every step of the treatment process, gave him the necessary care, and we felt very comfortable with the service. Thanks to this scare, we've found a vet for our little scavenger. Highly recommended. You've gained a new client!

PS: They were also very attentive, writing to me several times to ask how Athos is doing. It's a pleasure working with a team like this.
If you can't find another vet and the pet isn't too sick... I'd even go to another vet if I had to.
Amazing professionals who do their work with so much love.

On Monday, January 27th, my mother and I took our cat Roby to this clinic for his first annual vaccination and check-up.

(We came from a different vet, but I decided to switch because I didn't see that they treated animals with genuine dedication or professionalism. I was worried about whether they would take good care of Roby's health, so I switched to this one. And it's clear I wasn't wrong!)

Roby, even though he's a sweetheart and very well-behaved, has always been very afraid of the vet. But Alba, who saw him, was incredibly kind to him, and it made a huge difference!

It's the first time we've seen Roby so comfortable at the vet, and he got along wonderfully with Alba. She also gave him a thorough examination and told us that what he has appears to be a small, benign cyst, which put our minds at ease.

My mother and I left feeling incredibly happy with the wonderful care Alba gave our furry friend.
Without a doubt, I'll be taking him to her for all his future checkups. A million thanks!
